I'll create a molblock with 2D coordinates and wedge/hash bonds so that RDKit can perceive the stereochemistry, and then embed it into 3D.
RDKit is available. Now let me parse the molblock, verify stereo perception, and generate 3D coordinates.

import numpy as np

xyz = np.array(xyz)
def d(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j])
def dih(i,j,k,l):
    b1, b2, b3 = xyz[j]-xyz[i], xyz[k]-xyz[j], xyz[l]-xyz[k]
    n1, n2 = np.cross(b1,b2), np.cross(b2,b3)
    m = np.cross(n1, b2/np.linalg.norm(b2))
